name: AI Research Sourcing
description: Discovers relevant biofuel news articles using AI search engines (Perplexity daily, Anthropic weekly) and feeds them into the existing news ingestion pipeline. Expands content reach beyond manually curated sources.

parameters.content:
### Branch 1 — Daily Perplexity (Vertical Lenses)
Fires daily at 04:00 Europe/London. Reads vertical_perplexity Lenses, fans queries to Perplexity, posts URLs to content-sourcing, logs the run. If yield < 50% of cap, Anthropic fallback fires.

### Branch 2 — Weekly Anthropic VIP-hunter Lenses
Fires weekly Monday 06:00. Reads vip_anthropic Lenses, calls Anthropic /v1/messages with web_search (max_uses 3) per Lens. No VIPs seeded in V1 so this no-ops cleanly.

### Branch 3 — Anthropic Fallback (inline within Branch 1)
Fires when queued/cap < 0.5. Fetches the brief, calls Anthropic web_search, posts URLs, logs run with fallback=true.
